+import argparse, hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess
+
+REPO = pathlib.Path('/Users/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox')
+OUT = REPO / 'docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/pr-consumers'
+TMP = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/t4-prc-20261002')
+CASES = {
+    'contract-only-pr': 'clarify-docs', 'runtime-pr': 'clarify-docs',
+    'destination-visibility': 'clarify-docs', 'pr-missing-context': 'clarify-docs',
+    'pr-unavailable-source': 'clarify-docs', 'clarity-after-drafting': 'design',
+    'clarity-refined-documents-only': 'design', 'clarity-unchanged-resume': 'design',
+    'clarity-preserves-profile': 'document', 'clarity-unchanged-document': 'document',
+}
+
+def sha(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+def inventory(root):
+    return {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
+
+def export_json(path, data):
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def command(args, cwd):
+    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=cwd, text=True).strip()
+
+def stage():
+    if TMP.exists():
+        raise RuntimeError('Staging root already exists; preserve prior evidence')
+    instructions = TMP / 'instructions'
+    for skill in ('clarify-docs', 'design', 'document'):
+        source = REPO / 'klaude-plugin/skills' / skill
+        target = instructions / 'skills' / skill
+        target.mkdir(parents=True)
+        for p in source.iterdir():
+            if p.is_file() and p.suffix == '.md':
+                shutil.copyfile(p, target / p.name)
+    for profile in ('go', 'python', 'java', 'js_ts', 'kotlin', 'k8s', 'k8s-operator', 'skill-md'):
+        source = REPO / 'klaude-plugin/profiles' / profile
+        target = instructions / 'profiles' / profile
+        target.mkdir(parents=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(source / 'DETECTION.md', target / 'DETECTION.md')
+        for phase in ('design', 'document'):
+            if (source / phase).exists():
+                shutil.copytree(source / phase, target / phase)
+    shutil.copytree(instructions, OUT / 'instructions')
+    export_json(OUT / 'instruction-hashes.json', inventory(instructions))
+    export_json(OUT / 'source-revision.json', {'head': command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], REPO), 'status': command(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], REPO)})
+    for name, skill in CASES.items():
+        source = REPO / 'klaude-plugin/skills' / skill / 'evals' / name
+        workspace = TMP / name / 'workspace'
+        shutil.copytree(source / 'test-files', workspace)
+        evidence = OUT / name
+        evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(source / 'eval.json', evidence / 'eval.json')
+        if (source / 'oracle').exists():
+            shutil.copytree(source / 'oracle', evidence / 'oracle')
+        if (source / 'README.md').exists():
+            shutil.copyfile(source / 'README.md', evidence / 'eval-README.md')
+        git_evidence = None
+        if (workspace / 'snapshots').exists():
+            checkout = workspace / 'checkout'
+            checkout.mkdir()
+            command(['git', 'init', '-q'], checkout)
+            for rev in ('base', 'head'):
+                for child in checkout.iterdir():
+                    if child.name != '.git':
+                        shutil.rmtree(child) if child.is_dir() else child.unlink()
+                shutil.copytree(workspace / 'snapshots' / rev, checkout, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+                command(['git', 'add', '.'], checkout)
+                command(['git', '-c', 'user.name=Offline Fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid', 'commit', '-q', '-m', rev], checkout)
+                command(['git', 'tag', 'review-' + rev], checkout)
+            git_evidence = {
+                'base': command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'review-base'], checkout),
+                'head': command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'review-head'], checkout),
+                'diff': command(['git', 'diff', 'review-base', 'review-head'], checkout),
+                'status': command(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], checkout),
+            }
+            export_json(evidence / 'git-evidence.json', git_evidence)
+            shutil.rmtree(workspace / 'snapshots')
+        shutil.copytree(workspace, evidence / 'before')
+        export_json(evidence / 'before-hashes.json', inventory(workspace))
+        editable = {
+            'contract-only-pr': ['pr-draft.md'], 'runtime-pr': ['docs/feat/wip/prep/<one-unused-local-draft>.md'],
+            'destination-visibility': ['pr-draft.md'], 'pr-missing-context': [],
+            'pr-unavailable-source': ['drafts/pr-15.md'],
+            'clarity-after-drafting': ['docs/feat/wip/archive-label/design.md','docs/feat/wip/archive-label/implementation.md','docs/feat/wip/archive-label/tasks.md'],
+            'clarity-refined-documents-only': ['docs/feat/wip/archive-label/implementation.md'],
+            'clarity-unchanged-resume': [], 'clarity-preserves-profile': ['docs/operations.md'],
+            'clarity-unchanged-document': ['docs/archive-guide.md'],
+        }[name]
+        export_json(evidence / 'editor-manifest.json', {
+            'workspace': str(workspace), 'instruction_root': str(instructions),
+            'readable_fixture_files': list(inventory(workspace)),
+            'readable_instruction_files': list(inventory(instructions)),
+            'writes_relative_to_workspace': editable,
+            'network': False, 'git_writes': False,
+            'isolation': 'Shared filesystem; prompt boundary audited against complete native trace, not OS isolation.'
+        })
+    print(str(OUT))
+
+def after(name):
+    workspace = TMP / name / 'workspace'
+    evidence = OUT / name
+    shutil.copytree(workspace, evidence / 'after')
+    current = inventory(workspace)
+    before = json.loads((evidence / 'before-hashes.json').read_text())
+    export_json(evidence / 'after-hashes.json', current)
+    export_json(evidence / 'file-effects.json', {
+        'modified': [p for p in before if p in current and before[p] != current[p]],
+        'removed': sorted(set(before) - set(current)), 'created': sorted(set(current) - set(before)),
+    })
+
+def session(name, role, agent):
+    matches = list(pathlib.Path('/Users/sergio/.codex/sessions/2026/10/02').glob('*' + agent + '*.jsonl'))
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(matches)
+    target = OUT / name / role
+    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copyfile(matches[0], target / 'session.jsonl')
+    records = [json.loads(line) for line in matches[0].read_text().splitlines()]
+    readable = [r for r in records if r.get('type') in ('response_item','event_msg')]
+    export_json(target / 'tool-message-records.json', readable)
+    export_json(target / 'session-settings.json', [r for r in records if r.get('type') in ('session_meta','turn_context')])
+    finals = [r for r in records if r.get('type') == 'response_item' and r.get('payload',{}).get('type') == 'message' and r['payload'].get('role') == 'assistant' and r['payload'].get('phase') == 'final_answer']
+    if not finals:
+        finals = [r for r in records if r.get('type') == 'event_msg' and r.get('payload',{}).get('type') == 'agent_message'][-1:]
+    export_json(target / 'final-records.json', finals)
+    export_json(target / 'capture.json', {'agent_id':agent,'source':str(matches[0]),'trace_sha256':sha(target / 'session.jsonl'),'records':len(records),'role':role,'fork_turns':'none','model_override':None,'effort_override':None})
+    print(json.dumps({'agent':agent,'records':len(records),'bytes':matches[0].stat().st_size,'finals':len(finals)}))
+
+parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+parser.add_argument('action', choices=['stage','after','session'])
+parser.add_argument('args', nargs='*')
+args = parser.parse_args()
+{'stage': stage, 'after': after, 'session': session}[args.action](*args.args)
*** End Patch"));
